propositions: Escaped import breakages in subpackages and scripts/ modules are not caught by the current wheel-probe step, which only runs `import rebar` and entry-point `--help` calls
Scripts on sys.path insert their own directory process-wide in conftest, masking missing sys.path setup in sibling scripts (as occurred with alert_dedup)
A deterministic import walk must test every rebar.* module and every top-level scripts/*.py in isolation to catch all import failures and report them without fail-fast behavior

Expected optional modules (lazy-boundary dependencies like mcp, fastapi in extras) must be distinguished from real failures by checking both that the missing module name matches the declared dependency and that the dependency is uninstalled
The walk must be locally runnable from any venv without CI infrastructure and invocable as a make target for developer portability
